mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate trazodone's orthostatic hypotension and increase CNS depression risk; trazodone may further lower blood pressure and worsen electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (particularly potassium and sodium), and orthostatic symptoms; consider potassium supplementation or potassium-sparing agent if clinically indicated; counsel patient on fall precautions.
